# PLY2646 — construct outside the classic Visual Basic profile

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Message | `'<construct>' is not supported by the classic Visual Basic profile` |
| Severity | error |
| Exit code | 3 (UnsupportedConstruct) |
| Strict promotion | no |
| Rule | `visualbasic.frontend.construct` |
| Area | visualbasic |
| Owning issue | #1090 |
| Status | active |
| Seen in | standard error of polypiler translate --from visualbasic; stops import |

## Cause

The module uses a construct of classic Visual Basic that the `visualbasic` frontend does not import,
named in the message: a type (`Currency`, `Date`, `Object`, …), a statement (`GoSub`, `With`, `For
Each`, …), or a `Variant` whose result would depend on what the frontend does not model. A `Variant`
is imported (see the [frontend](../../architecture/VISUALBASIC-FRONTEND.md#variant)); it is refused
where the kinds it may hold make the result depend on the locale - the text of a `Single` or a
`Double`, a `String` read as a number - or where an operation on a dynamic `Variant` is not modelled
yet: bitwise operators on integers, `Eqv`, `Imp`, a `LongLong` in a `Variant`, a `Variant` array.

## Example

```text
$ polypiler translate Report.bas --from visualbasic --to csharp --output out
Report.bas(7,1): error PLY2646: 'the text of a Variant that may hold a Double, which Visual Basic writes by the locale' is not supported by the classic Visual Basic profile
```

for

```vb
Dim v
v = 1
v = v / 3
Debug.Print v
```

## What to do

Give the value the type its use needs: convert it where its kind matters (`CLng(v)` before writing an
integer), keep numbers and strings in separate variables, or declare the variable with its type. A construct outside the profile has to be
rewritten in the subset the [frontend](../../architecture/VISUALBASIC-FRONTEND.md) lists.
